nom: PEACH & LILY Power Calm Hydrating Gel Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including a T-zone-oily user and one whose partner has oilier skin, report the cleanser removes excess oil and can be used daily without issue, though one oily/acne-prone user with breakouts found it unimpressive and hard to rinse.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report it cleanses without stripping or leaving skin tight, though a couple mention needing to pair it with extra moisturizer or that it can feel slightly drying for them personally.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports it keeps her moisturized while still clearing away oil.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin repeatedly describe it as calming and non-irritating, including one user with rosacea and one with eczema who report no flare-ups, though one reviewer reports a rash and redness from the product.
segments.normal: No substantive reports specific to normal skin were found in these reviews.
segments.mature: No substantive reports specific to mature skin were found in these reviews.

concerns.aging: No reviewers specifically discuss anti-aging effects with this cleanser.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the gel cleanses without dehydrating or stripping skin, describing it as hydrating; one reviewer with sensitive/dry skin notes she still needs to follow with multiple moisturizers, and another says it can be a little drying for her personally.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness, including one with rosacea and one whose skin used to be red in areas; a couple mention using it to calm irritated or reactive skin.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe the cleanser as gentle enough not to disrupt their skin's usual comfort, with one reviewer specifically noting no eczema flare-ups since using it.
concerns.spots: No reviews specifically distinguish dark spots or hyperpigmentation as an outcome.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several reviewers, including ones acne-prone or with cystic acne, describe reduced breakouts or improved acne over time, but two reviewers report increased pimples or blemishes after use, and one reviewer describes a mold/packaging issue possibly linked to a breakout.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or T-zone oiliness report it cleans away excess oil while leaving skin balanced rather than stripped, with no reports of it increasing oiliness.

extraits.texte: This is the second Peach & Lily face wash I've tried and yet again I am not impressed. I tried this face wash after doing some research on what to use for my oily skin and break outs. Out of all of the options, I chose this one since Peach & Lily are all the rage right now. First wash, it was difficult to rinse off even though I only used a dime like instructed. I liked how my skin felt afterwards. I had a couple of pimples and after a week of using it, I have a ton more. I'm not typically acne prone but my skin wasn't in a good place after using the other face wash. I am not impressed, once again, to say the least. Oh, and it is EXPENSIVE. It is definitely not worth the money.

extraits.titre: Gentle cleanser that works even for sensitive dry skin
extraits.texte: I have incredibly sensitive and very dry skin. I usually use 2-3 moisturizers both morning and night and I used to never wash with any sort of cleanser - just water, and that's where my skin has been happiest so far. But I got a sample of this and decided to try it because I do need a general cleanser for when I do full makeup, and I have to say, this is the first cleanser where I felt I can use it every day and still have the freshly cleansed feeling. I still need to use all my moisturizers immediately after but I don't need EXTRA moisturizers which is key. However, I still cannot use it both day and night as the directions suggest - my skin started being unhappy when I tried that frequency. But as soon as I went back to only night use, my skin was happy, so that's why I've only given it 4 stars, but otherwise, it's my favorite cleanser

As someone with dry and acne prone skin it's hard to find a cleanser that doesn't break me out but also hydrates me and this one does the job flawlessly! My skin never feels stripped like after using acne cleansers and it looks so bright and smooth!

extraits.titre: I will continue to buy this product.
extraits.texte: I love Peach & Lily Power Calm Hydrating Gel Cleanser. It is hydrating and soothing for my rosacea.

I recently bought this for my boyfriend to use instead the other drug store cleanser he was using. He has very sensitive and fair skin and has loved using this cleanser. This paired with other Peach and Lily products has helped his skin so much with being less red, dry, and acne prone.

Love this. We got the large size because I use it and my boyfriend. great face wash. Can be a little drying for me so I rotate it with another one. But my boyfriend with oilier skin can use it everyday just fine.
I use this face wash every morning and night and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I also have eczema and I haven't had a flare up since using this
